units.source_text: 匂亲王返京，依旧回到二条院。

en.t: Prince Niou returned to the capital and went back, as before, to the Nijo residence.

units.source_text: 他身心非常困恼，饮食也不能进。

en.t: He was in such distress of body and mind that he could not even eat or drink.

units.source_text: 过了几天之后，面色发青，身体消瘦，样子完全变了。

en.t: After a few days, his face turned pale, his body grew thin, and his appearance changed completely.

units.source_text: 皇上以下所有亲故，都替他担忧，

en.t: Everyone close to him, from the emperor on down, worried about him,

units.source_text: 每天有许多人来问病，门庭若市。

en.t: and every day many people came to ask after his health, so that his gate was as busy as a marketplace.

units.source_text: 因此给浮舟的信，也不能写得详细。

en.t: Because of this, he could not write in detail even in his letters to Ukifune.

units.source_text: 在宇治方面，那个爱管闲事的乳母，

en.t: At Uji, meanwhile, that meddlesome nurse

units.source_text: 因为女儿分娩要她照顾，久已出门去了，此时方才回来。

en.t: had long been away looking after her daughter during childbirth, and only now returned.

units.source_text: 浮舟忌惮她，也不能放心地仔细阅读匂亲王的来信。

en.t: Ukifune was wary of her and could not calmly read Prince Niou's letter with care.

units.source_text: 浮舟住在如此荒僻的地方，

en.t: Ukifune lived in such a remote and desolate place,

units.source_text: 所指望的只是薰大将的照拂，静待他来迎接。

en.t: and all she could hope for was General Kaoru's protection as she quietly waited for him to come and fetch her.

units.source_text: 她母亲也很欣慰，认为此事虽然不是公开的，

en.t: Her mother, too, was much relieved, thinking that although the matter was not public,

units.source_text: 但薰大将已决心于最近期内来接，

en.t: General Kaoru had already resolved to come for her very soon,

units.source_text: 则不久定能迁居京中，这真是很体面、很可喜之事。

en.t: so before long she would surely be able to move to the capital, which was a most respectable and happy prospect.

units.source_text: 因此她早已物色适当的侍女，

en.t: For that reason, her mother had already been looking for suitable serving women,

units.source_text: 选取相貌漂亮的女童，送到宇治山庄。

en.t: and she selected pretty young girls and sent them to the villa at Uji.

units.source_text: 浮舟心中也觉得这是当然之事，从当初就是指望如此的。

en.t: Ukifune herself also felt in her heart that this was only natural, for she had hoped for it from the beginning.

units.source_text: 然而她一想起那个热狂的匂亲王，

en.t: Yet whenever she thought of that impassioned Prince Niou,

units.source_text: 他那妬恨的神色和诉说的言语都浮现到她脑际来，

en.t: his jealous expression and pleading words all came back into her mind,

units.source_text: 便觉昏沉欲睡，一合眼就梦见匂亲王的姿态，

en.t: and she would feel dazed and drowsy, and as soon as she closed her eyes she would dream of Prince Niou's figure.

units.source_text: 连她自己也觉得讨厌。

en.t: Even she herself found this distasteful.
